═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
TRADE WATCHDOG — WARNING (2 of 3 open trades against the tape)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

Open Trades: 3 (1 long, 2 short) | oldest 2.0h | unrealized -0.08 USDT
Regime: LONG_BIAS — aggregate 100 long / 1 short / 25 neutral (regime_5m 20:00),
        BTC 15m LONG_BIAS + BTC 4h LONG_BIAS, continuum 1m AT EMA300 (64823 vs
        64837, reclaimed 19:10 and held ~58min), wyckoff MARKUP / RECOVERY,
        volume_ratio 0.41 LOW | Volatility NORMAL | flips/24h = 24 agg / 25 BTC

── Steers ──────────────────────────────────────
🟡 [regime] BTC SHORT #16936 — age=4 cycles unexecuted. RETRACTED — prior steer
   "EXIT TRIGGER MET" (19:45). Re-tested at 20:10: leg 1 (1m holds above EMA300
   15-30m) is NO LONGER true — 1m reclaimed EMA300 at 19:10, held ~58min, then
   printed AT/slightly below the line (closes 64823-64836 vs EMA300 64837); leg 2
   (aggregate LONG_BIAS) still true — 4 consecutive LONG_BIAS dumps since 19:15.
   Compound condition not both-true, so reissue conditional: HOLD only while 1m
   stays below 64837; EXIT if 1m closes >=64850 for 10 consecutive minutes while
   aggregate stays LONG_BIAS. SL 65171 hard / TP 63609 unchanged. Regime is still
   against this trade (BTC own 5m LONG_BIAS 59.8, entry meta_rsi 70.6) — the exit
   re-arms the moment 1m reclaims the line.
🟡 [cluster] 2 shorts / 1 long against a 100/1 LONG_BIAS aggregate with BTC 15m
   and 4h both LONG_BIAS — net-short book on a markup tape. No third short while
   aggregate long_bias >=50 AND BTC 1m >= EMA300. If BTC 1m closes >=64850, cut to
   at most one short (the MET lock) until the tape rotates.
🟡 [health] MET SHORT #16940 — age=2 cycles unexecuted. Entered 19:20 at meta_rsi
   85.2 while its own coin was already LONG_BIAS 83.5 and +0.71%/80m. HOLD only
   while 5m closes <0.2685; EXIT on 2 consecutive 5m closes >0.2685 (re-tested
   20:10: 20:05 close 0.26802, 20:10 close 0.26710 → trigger clear). SL 0.26997
   (+0.89%) / TP 0.26222 (-1.99%). Would not open this fresh — extreme-fade short
   into a strong long tape, no add.
🟡 [health] ARB LONG #16939 — direction correct (own LONG_BIAS 56.4, meta_rsi 60,
   aligned with tape) but the btc-pump-rider+ thesis needs a pump: BTC volume_ratio
   0.41 (LOW), 1m flat on EMA300, and ARB 5m closes walked 0.1353 → 0.13434 over
   25min; trade -0.53% with only 0.34% left to SL 0.13388. HOLD only while BTC 1m
   holds >=64837; EXIT on an ARB 5m close <0.1340 rather than donate the last 0.3%
   to the stop.
🟢 [profit_lock] None triggered — best open trade is MET +0.18%, so no trade has
   crossed +2% (breakeven rule) or +5% (trail rule); no trade open 8+ hours (oldest
   2.0h). MNT SHORT #16931 closed 19:50 via profit-monster-trail +$0.03 on MFE 0.70
   — consistent with the prior cycle's arm-and-lock recommendation.

── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────
The book is on the wrong side of a tape that rotated long at 19:15 and has stayed
long for four straight 15m dumps (aggregate 100/1 at 20:00; BTC 15m and 4h both
LONG_BIAS; wyckoff MARKUP). Both shorts entered on the earlier bear leg: BTC SHORT
at 18:07 (meta_rsi 70.6) and MET SHORT at 19:20 (meta_rsi 85.2 — ten minutes after
the flip). Winning side in the last 24h was long momentum: ZRO +11.0%, CHIP +6.9%,
XAI +4.9%, BTC +4.7% — all LONGs, all entered at meta_rsi <=63. We were shorting
the side that paid.

Would I open these fresh today? BTC SHORT: no — own 5m LONG_BIAS 59.8 and 1m has
been above EMA300 since 19:10; the only reason to keep it is that 1m is now sitting
on the line, so a break back below re-aligns the trade (condition-keyed hold above).
MET SHORT: no — shorting meta_rsi 85.2 while MET itself is LONG_BIAS 83.5 and
rising 0.71%/80m is the same extreme-fade that lost both ways yesterday (#16915 BTC
SHORT @27.6 -$0.56, #16916 BTC LONG @80.7 -$0.15); exit is conditional, no add.
ARB LONG: yes, the direction is right — but it is a pump-rider with volume_ratio at
0.41 and BTC flat on EMA300, so there is no pump to ride; it earns its place only
while BTC holds the line.

Over-rotation caution applies: flips/24h = 24 aggregate / 25 BTC (p95 = 26), so an
average direction state survives about an hour. Every steer above is keyed to a
re-testable market condition, and the unconditional BTC exit was retracted precisely
because its EMA300 leg reverted within one cycle.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────
1. BTC SHORT #16936: keep it only below 64837 — exit if 1m closes >=64850 for 10
   consecutive minutes while aggregate stays LONG_BIAS; SL 65171 stays hard.
   (Supersedes the retracted "exit now" steer, age=4 cycles unexecuted.)
2. MET SHORT #16940: no add; exit on 2 consecutive 5m closes >0.2685. Current
   closes (0.26710) are clear.
3. ARB LONG #16939: exit on 5m close <0.1340 or if BTC 1m loses 64837 with 5m
   closes <64750 — pump-rider thesis is dead without volume.
4. No third short while aggregate long_bias >=50 and BTC 1m >= EMA300.
5. AI Trader: NO new pick this cycle — last pick SEI LONG written 19:44 (24 min
   old, inside the 45-min TTL) and AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False, so it stays
   watchlist-only regardless.
6. KPIs: chop-bleed dollar share 7d 84.8% (56 losers, 0 NULL mfe) / 14d 90.3%
   (123 losers, 0 NULL) / 30d 90.7% (299 losers, 0 NULL) — all under the >=92
   entry-quality breach, but 14d is +4.7pt and 30d +10.1pt vs the 2026-10-25
   baselines; 24h same-day arm 53.8% (14/26); 7d LONG arm 42.5% (17/40) is below
   the 50% tripwire → LONG entries are failing to reach +0.40% (entry ownership,
   not exit).

All figures re-run from PostgreSQL this cycle (meta_rsi from
_signal_metadata, never entry_rsi_14).

1. CHOP-BLEED DOLLAR SHARE (gross-loss share from trades that never reached
   +0.40% MFE): 7d 84.8% ($ share, 56 losers, 0 NULL mfe_pct) / 14d 90.3% (123
   losers, 0 NULL) / 30d 90.7% (299 losers, 0 NULL). Baselines 2026-10-25 were
   84.1 / 85.6 / 80.6 — 7d flat, 14d +4.7pt, 30d +10.1pt, still below the >=92
   entry-quality breach and far above the <=70 exit-ownership flip, so ownership
   stays on the ENTRY side. Companions: 24h same-day arm 53.8% (14/26); 7d LONG
   arm rate 42.5% (17/40) — below the 50% tripwire.

2. EXTREME meta_rsi ENTRIES, 24h (n=13 losers, 12 with meta_rsi): 5 entered at
   meta_rsi <=30 or >=72 and averaged -$0.18 each; the other 7 averaged -$0.08.
   Worst single trade #16915 BTC SHORT @ meta_rsi 27.6, -$0.56, manual_sl_hit with
   MFE 1.24 — we shorted an oversold knife, so the WINNING side was LONG from that
   same level, and #16916 BTC LONG @80.7 (-$0.15) shows the mirror: chasing an
   extreme in either direction is the error. Small n — directional evidence, not a
   gate. Both currently open shorts carry extreme entries (MET 85.2, BTC 70.6).

3. hard_max_loss = CHOP ENTRY SIGNATURE: 3 of the 13 24h losers closed
   hard_max_loss (ALGO SHORT @66.7 -$0.11, DYDX SHORT @72.1 -$0.14, BTC LONG
   @50.7 -$0.10) = $0.35 of $1.31 gross loss, all with MFE <=0.08, i.e. none ever
   armed. We entered in chop and the trail never got a chance — confirms the
   entry-quality reading in (1).

4. SIGNAL FAMILIES, 7d n>=4 — dead-signal check first: ATR_TREND_ACCEL±, BTC_PUMP_RIDER,
   JUP_YOLO, HL_COPY_SIGNAL+/- all ENABLED=True in hermes_constants.py with live 7d
   traffic, so none is a stale-window artefact and each is fair to flag:
   atr-trend- 26T -$0.23 WR 61.5% (winners smaller than losers; 2 of our 3 open
   trades are this family), jup_yolo_mirrored 21T -$0.39 WR 52.4%, atr-trend+ 5T
   -$0.13 WR 40%, hl_copy_trader 5T -$0.21 WR 0% (n=5 only). ai-trader-pending 31T
   +$0.32 WR 35.5%. Parameter changes are brain-auditor territory — watchdog flags
   only.

5. RIGHT-SIDE ANSWER FOR THE OPEN SHORTS: the 24h winners were long momentum
   (ZRO +11.0% @30.8, CHIP +6.9% @44.2, XAI +4.9% @40.0, BTC +4.7% @62.8) while the
   aggregate printed 100 long / 1 short. Both open shorts are on the side that did
   not pay. If the tape stays LONG_BIAS, the money is on longs at mid-band RSI in
   coins with their own 5m LONG_BIAS — which is exactly the SEI setup already on the
   watchlist from 19:44.
